capabilities.rationale: Local registration and sign-in routes are implemented through the generated site-bound auth backend.
The generated runtime uses an AutoTrader-specific SQLite identity and deterministic local storage boundary.
The ZIP provides guidance UI only; it does not issue or consume recovery codes.
Runtime templates remain generated but no real or simulated delivery journey is claimed.
Vehicle listing confirmation is an offline preview, not an order.
No payment journey is implemented; the runtime retains local-sandbox as a safety default only.
